name: 4-HO-αMT
summary: 4-HO-αMT (developmental code name MP-14), also known as 4-hydroxy-α-methyltryptamine, is a psychedelic drug of the tryptamine and α-alkyltryptamine families. It is a close structural analogue of α-methyltryptamine (αMT) and produces similar effects to it, but with exacerbated side effects similarly to 5-MeO-αMT. The drug is taken orally.

pharmacology.text: 4-HO-AMT has been found to produce electroencephalogram (EEG) changes in animals. 4-Hydroxylation of dimethyltryptamine (DMT) into the related compound psilocin (4-HO-DMT) has been found to abolish its serotonin release induction in human embryonic kidney 293 (HEK293) stably transfected with the serotonin transporter (SERT) in vitro.

sideEffects.en: It is reported to cause stronger body effects than αMT, such as nausea, vomiting, muscle tension, a racing heart, anxiety and restlessness. Drugs of the α-methyltryptamine group can also raise the risk of serotonin syndrome, which can be life-threatening.
sideEffects.zh: 據報告，它的身體反應比αMT更強，例如噁心、嘔吐、肌肉緊繃、心跳急促、焦慮與坐立不安。α-甲基色胺類藥物也可能提高血清素症候群的風險，這種狀況可能危及生命。
sideEffects.zhHans: 据报告，它的身体反应比αMT更强，例如恶心、呕吐、肌肉紧绷、心跳急促、焦虑与坐立不安。α-甲基色胺类药物也可能提高血清素症候群的风险，这种状况可能危及生命。

fact.en: It combines two famous features: the 4-hydroxy group of psilocin and the α-methyl group of αMT. αMT itself was briefly sold as an antidepressant called Indopan in the Soviet Union in the 1960s.
fact.zh: 它結合了兩個著名的結構特徵：脫磷酸裸蓋菇素的4-羥基，以及αMT的α-甲基。αMT本身在1960年代曾以「Indopan」的名稱在蘇聯短暫作為抗憂鬱藥販售。
fact.zhHans: 它结合了两个著名的结构特征：脱磷酸裸盖菇素的4-羟基，以及αMT的α-甲基。αMT本身在1960年代曾以「Indopan」的名称在苏联短暂作为抗忧郁药贩售。
